tasks.label: Compile and run active Java file
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $jdk = 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-25.0.5.0.3'; $root = '${workspaceFolder}'; $file = '${file}'; $classes = Join-Path $root '.java_classes'; $input = Join-Path $root 'input.txt'; $output = Join-Path $root 'output.txt'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $classes | Out-Null; & (Join-Path $jdk 'bin\javac.exe') -d $classes -sourcepath $root $file; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $package = Select-String -Path $file -Pattern '^\s*package\s+([^;]+);' | Select-Object -First 1; $mainClass = if ($package) { $package.Matches.Groups[1].Value + '.' + [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($file) } else { [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($file) }; $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo; $psi.FileName = Join-Path $jdk 'bin\java.exe'; $psi.Arguments = '-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -cp "' + $classes + '" ' + $mainClass; $psi.WorkingDirectory = $root; $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.RedirectStandardInput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true; $psi.StandardOutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $psi.StandardErrorEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $p = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process; $p.StartInfo = $psi; [void]$p.Start(); $stdoutTask = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(); $stderrTask = $p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(); $inputText = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($input); $p.StandardInput.Write($inputText); $p.StandardInput.Close(); $p.WaitForExit(); $stdout = $stdoutTask.Result; $stderr = $stderrTask.Result; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($output, $stdout, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false))); if ($stderr) { Write-Host $stderr }; exit $p.ExitCode
